language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the interface language. It is saved in this browser and applies to every GenOVA screen.

form.title: Personal details
form.description: Your name and email appear on the OVAs you create and in the platform listings.

fields.universityIdHint: Numbers only, no spaces or hyphens.
fields.genderOther: Other or prefer not to say
fields.phoneHint: Include the country code, for example +51987285992.

emailChange.currentPasswordHint: Required to change your account email.
emailChange.passwordRequired: Enter your current password to change your email.

totpField.label: Verification code (2FA)
totpField.hint: The one from your authenticator app.

pendingEmail.notice: Your current email is still active. We sent a code to {{email}}: enter it here to complete the change.

password.title: Password
password.description: Use a password you don't use on other sites.
password.newHint: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Your account is deactivated and your personal data is anonymized. Your OVAs are kept without your authorship. This can't be undone.
delete.modalDescription: Your account will be deactivated and your personal data anonymized. Your OVAs are kept, but without your authorship. This action can't be undone.

totp.title: Two-step verification
totp.idleDescription: In addition to your password, you'll be asked for a code from an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator or Authy when you sign in.
totp.enabledDescription: When you sign in, besides your password you're asked for a code from your authenticator app.
totp.disableCodeHint: The 6-digit code your authenticator app is showing now.
totp.setupDescription: Add GenOVA to your authenticator app and confirm with the code it generates.
totp.codeInvalid: Enter the 6 digits shown in your app.
totp.step1: Scan the code with your app (Google Authenticator, Authy, Microsoft Authenticator…).
totp.step2: Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app below.
totp.manualHint: Can't scan it? Add the account manually with this key:
totp.qrTitle: QR code to add GenOVA to your authenticator app

backupCodes.title: Backup codes
backupCodes.description: Save them now in a safe place: they won't be shown again. Each one works once if you lose access to your app.

validation.fullNameMin: The name must be at least 3 characters long.
validation.universityIdDigits: The ID must contain numbers only.
validation.universityIdMin: The ID must be 1 or greater.
validation.phoneFormat: The phone number can only contain digits and the + sign.
validation.passwordMin: Must be at least 8 characters long.
